_comments: THE B2B MOTION — six stages, master plan §4.2.
The winning stage is called 'Signed', not 'Closed Won', and that is the point rather than
flavour: the app knows it is a win because the stage points at a DealStatusType carrying
IsWon = 1. Nothing compares the name. Rename it to 'Papered' in a deployment and every rollup,
every policy branch and every check keeps working.
RequiresDealLines = 1: this motion sells catalogue products, so its deals carry order lines and
Deal.Amount is a CACHE of the order total rather than a typed figure.
IsDefault = 1 so a fresh install has an obvious place to put the first deal.
CloseWonPolicy carries no OrderState key. It was retired (D-OS1) in favour of
PipelineStage.OrderStatusOnEntry, which can speak on every stage change rather than only at the
moment of a won close. OneTimeLinesTo is still here and is DEAD -- close-won creates no order
now, so nothing routes lines. See DECISIONS-NEEDED.md DN-11.
ContractTypeCode is 'Order Form', which is a type contracts actually ships. It said 'Standard'
first and nothing on any host is called that -- v2's ContractType carries no Code column, so the
seam resolves on NAME, and an unresolvable name means close-won plans a contract it can never
create. Found by close-won-contract.CT1 the moment contracts became readable.

fields.Name: B2B
fields.Description: The main motion: catalogue products, a proposal, a negotiation and a signed agreement. The winning stage is called Signed — the app reads the status type's IsWon flag, never the stage name.

_comments: THE D2C MOTION — three stages, and a different shape rather than a shorter one.
RequiresDealLines = 0: these deals never carry catalogue lines, so the amount is a figure a
human states and AmountIsComputed stays 0. That is the L-2 SIMPLE deal, and it is why
DealEntityServer's amount cache must never overwrite a typed number (save-deal.SD22).
Its policy creates no contract, which is what makes the pair worth shipping together: the same
close action down two pipelines produces two different outcomes, decided by the POLICY and not
by the status.

fields.Name: D2C
fields.Description: A direct motion with no catalogue lines and no agreement: the amount is stated by a human, and closing it routes nothing downstream.
